create_meili_index: run the CLI script to create a Meilisearch index for docs semantic search with an API key and URL
create_temp_meili_index: run the CLI script with --temp flag to create a temporary Meilisearch index instead of the main one
create_embedding_db: call create_embedding_db to initialize a Meilisearch index with the provided client and index name
update_db_settings: call update_db_settings to configure Meilisearch index settings for semantic search
run_meilisearch_client: instantiate a meilisearch.Client with a URL and API key to connect to a Meilisearch instance
